item.title: Starlink satellites used to probe Earth's upper atmosphere
item.description: Researchers have developed a novel method to observe the upper atmosphere using orbital data from Starlink satellites, which is typically hard to study.

item.title: Ancient skeletons challenge syphilis origin theories
item.description: New findings from Vietnam suggest diseases like yaws may have been transmitted from mother to child thousands of years ago, a pattern often overlooked.

item.title: Adult brain shows greater self-repair capacity than previously thought
item.description: New research in mice reveals that the adult brain may have a higher capacity for self-repair than once believed, with a specific group of support cells playing a key role.

item.title: Hidden brain rhythm identified that may enhance Parkinson's treatment
item.description: Researchers have identified a brain network and its unique electrical rhythm that may influence the effectiveness of deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease.
